spec.description:
Sisalation Vapawrap Vapour Permeable Metal Roof is a synthetic,
Class 4 vapour-permeable roof sarking membrane specifically engineered for use
under residential and commercial metal roof claddings. Formulated with a
microporous water-resistant film sandwiched between two layers of mould- and
shrink-resistant spun-bonded polyolefin, it provides superior heat shrink
resistance compared to traditional polymer-weave membranes under hot metal
decks. It allows water vapour to escape from roof cavities while functioning as
an air and liquid water barrier that safely drains condensation into gutters.
features:
Specifically designed for use under metal roof claddings in
residential and commercial buildings

High heat shrink resistance, preventing
thermal degradation and stretching under hot metal roofs

Class 4 Vapour
Permeable membrane preventing interstitial condensation accumulation

Acts as
a continuous water barrier directing leaks and condensation into the gutter

Triple-layer construction: microporous core between spun-bonded polyolefin
layers

High tensile strength reduces tearing and scuffing during metal
roofing installation
Resists mould, mildew, and biological attack

Low
flammability index compliant with AS 1530.2

Suitable for bushfire-prone areas
up to BAL-40 under AS 3959

install:
Install as a continuous membrane over rafters/trusses beneath metal roof
battens, or draped between battens

Roll out horizontally starting from the
eaves, ensuring lower edge drains directly into the gutter

Allow a
minimum 150mm overlap for horizontal laps (or 50mm if fully taped with VapaSeam
tape)

Allow a nominal 40mm drape between framing members to create a drainage
channel for condensation

Fix temporarily with staples or clouts to rafters,
then secure permanently with roof battens

Tape all laps, penetrations, and
ridgelines with Sisalation VapaSeam Tape for complete airtightness

Fix metal
roof cladding directly to battens above the membrane
selection_checklist: Confirm roof cladding is profiled metal deck or corrugated steel

Verify
requirement for Class 4 vapour-permeable roof sarking to satisfy NCC
condensation management
Measure total roof area including 150mm overlaps
Confirm compatibility with batten spacing and rafter spans
accessories: Safety wire mesh (where required for commercial spans)
limitations:
Designed specifically for metal roof applications; do not use
as a primary roof cladding

Must not be left exposed to direct UV sunlight
beyond manufacturer recommended exposure time

Ensure membrane has continuous
fall to gutters without reverse laps or ponding

retrieval.rag_summary:
Sisalation Vapawrap Vapour Permeable
Metal Roof is a Medium Duty, Class 4 vapour-permeable synthetic roof sarking
membrane developed specifically for profiled metal roofs. Fabricated from
spun-bonded polyolefin non-woven layers sandwiching a microporous core, it
delivers outstanding heat-shrink resistance to remain taut beneath hot metal
decks. Allowing moisture vapour to vent freely while preventing water leaks and
drafts, it complies with AS/NZS 4200.1, AS 1530.2 (Flammability Index ≤ 5), and
AS 3959 (up to BAL-40) to mitigate roof condensation.
